result.summary: Found 1 major issue regarding duplicate content in the restaurant list.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section displays two identical cards for 'Green Bowl Poké' consecutively, including the same image, delivery time (15-25 min), and delivery fee (€0.90).
issues.suggestion: Investigate the data fetching or UI rendering logic to prevent duplicate restaurant listings from being displayed in the same carousel.
